description: This file defines the ToyVpnService class, a custom Android Service implementation for managing a VPN connection. It handles starting, stopping, and maintaining VPN connections using Android's VpnService API, managing connection states, notifications, and threads.

classes.name: ToyVpnService
classes.description: An Android foreground service that manages VPN connections, including establishing, maintaining, and disconnecting VPN tunnels. It manages notification updates and thread handling for VPN lifecycle.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A simple container class extending Pair, holding a thread and a ParcelFileDescriptor representing a VPN connection instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up the Handler and PendingIntent for configuration.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands to connect or disconnect the VPN based on received intents.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by disconnecting the VPN when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles messages for UI updates, such as showing connection status via Toast and updating foreground notifications.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a VPN connection, showing a connecting status, and extracting preferences to start the connection process.

methods.name: startConnection
methods.description: Starts a new VPN connection thread with the specified connection parameters.

methods.name: setConnectingThread
methods.description: Updates the current connection thread, interrupting any existing thread.

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Sets the current active connection, closing previous if any.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Stops the VPN connection, updating the state and UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateForegroundNotification
methods.description: Creates or updates the ongoing notification indicating VPN status.
